name: Succu Ari Apart
source:
Souji Kobashi, burdened by a bitter past due to his larger-than-average size. Seizing the chance of university admission, he resolved to start anew in a place with no acquaintances, connections, or ties—only to find his new home was

"Sakyuu-wa So-Sou":
Rent: ¥39,840!
Close to Station & University!
Various Supports Available!

run by a stunningly beautiful landlady of a certain age named Nadeshiko.

“Well then, since you've seen the place... shall we proceed with the tenant screening?”
“Huh, landlady!? Why are you naked!?”

Under the guise of the screening, Souji loses his virginity. Nadeshiko then informs him that every resident of this apartment is a fallen succubus with their own issues.

"In exchange for renting you this room at a super low price, I want you to support those girls so they can become proper succubi.
With that big, impressive cock of yours, anytime, anywhere, 24/7, 365 days a year... okay?"

And so, his new life with the dropout succubi begins.

translation:
小桥总司因体型偏大而背负着痛苦的过去。抓住考大学的机会，他决心在一个没有熟人、没有关系、没有关系的地方重新开始，却发现他的新家是《Sakyuu-wa So-Sou》：
租金：39,840日元！
靠近车站和大学！
提供各种支持！

经营者是一位相当漂亮的女房东，名叫抚子。

“那么，既然你已经看过这个地方了……我们可以继续进行租户筛选吗？”
“啊，房东太太！？你怎么光着身子啊！？”

在放映的幌子下，总司失去了童贞。然后抚子告诉他，这间公寓的每个居民都是堕落的魅魔，都有自己的问题。

“作为以超低价格租给你这个房间的交换条件，我希望你能支持那些女孩，让她们成为真正的魅魔。
拥有你那令人印象深刻的大鸡巴，随时随地，一年365天，每天24/7……好吗？”

就这样，他与辍学的魅魔的新生活开始了。
